_note: REFRESHED (16) for the hover cards (2026-09-17), per docs/react-performance.md rule 10's deliberate-change path - never by widening the guard. All four planner scenarios moved DOWN: P-02 8290->7060 (-1230), P-03 14381->12300 (-2081), P-04 7440->6376 (-1064), P-05 2450->2087 (-363). One structural cause: every gear and ability tile in a roster row used to carry its own always-mounted base-ui Tooltip subtree (Root/Trigger/Portal, reconciling on every commit the row took); the hover card is now a hook the art primitive itself calls, and its trigger is a bare span until the first pointer reaches it, so a row's icons cost no component per commit until one is hovered - fewer components than the native-title era the previous refresh replaced, since the tiles' old Tooltips are gone too. Two intermediate captures on the way, neither landed: the first CI capture of this branch, with a wrapper component and an always-mounted Tooltip per tile, moved all four UP (8681/15137/7901/2564); the lazy trigger as a wrapper component took them to 7561/13150/6816/2237; folding the trigger into the primitives removed the wrapper's own render per commit and gave the numbers here. One nondeterminism found and closed: a peek under the resting pointer arms itself when a dialog opens beneath it, and P-04 read 7 renders higher on the CI runner than on the host (one armed peek on every commit of the window) - the harness now parks the pointer at (0,0) after every precondition. Numbers are the host capture (PERF_FORCE=1 after perf:build:profile), identical across two repetitions; the CI capture of the parked harness is expected to reproduce them exactly. Previous note: REFRESHED (15) for converting the hero strip's native title tooltips to the design-system Tooltip (2026-09-15, #230), per docs/react-performance.md rule 10's deliberate-change path - never by widening the guard. All four planner scenarios moved UP: P-02 7934->8290 (+356), P-03 13952->14381 (+429), P-04 7314->7440 (+126), P-05 2399->2450 (+51). One structural cause: four native `title` tips on the always-mounted hero strip (the truncated hero name, and the Sustained/Active/Hit figures) became DS Tooltips, and each base-ui Tooltip subtree (Root/Trigger/Portal/Positioner/Popup) reconciles on every commit the strip takes - the same per-commit cost AbbreviatedNumber carries, which #230 cited as the correct pattern. Memoising does not remove it: the cost is the primitive's own subtree per commit, not prop churn (the same finding the sheet-table measurement recorded). Numbers are the CI capture of this change; render counts are deterministic, so the local host capture (PERF_FORCE=1 after perf:build:profile) reproduces them exactly. Previous note: REFRESHED (14) for the shared gear slot card (2026-09-14), per docs/react-performance.md rule 10's deliberate-change path - never by widening the guard. The three scenarios that render the Gear tab moved DOWN: P-03 13986->13952 (-34), P-04 7328->7314 (-14), P-05 2405->2399 (-6); P-02 is unchanged at 7934, so the memo(SlotEditor) boundary rule 6 protects still holds. One structural cause: the per-slot stats grid that mounted eight stat boxes as a second row under the slot editors is gone - each SlotEditor now wraps one GearSlotCard that draws the item and its stats together - so every commit that reaches the Gear tab renders eight fewer components. The CI capture of the change (13952/7314/2399) and the local capture on the host (PERF_FORCE=1 after perf:build:profile) agree exactly, deterministic across repetitions. Previous note: REFRESHED (13) for the front page (2026-09-14), per docs/react-performance.md rule 10's deliberate-change path - never by widening the guard. All four scenarios moved UP by a few renders over the toast-hosting baseline: P-02 7912->7934 (+22), P-03 13939->13986 (+47), P-04 7307->7328 (+21), P-05 2396->2405 (+9). One structural cause: the site header carries a sixth nav tab (Home), one more link drawn on every header commit; the quick guide the planner used to mount above itself is gone, which is why the increase is smaller than one tab's worth. Measured on the same host with the same method, on the branch rebased onto the baseline's own develop commit. Previous note: REFRESHED (12) for hosting the shell toast in the app shell instead of the planner slot (2026-09-14), per docs/react-performance.md rule 10's deliberate-change path - never by widening the guard, which compares exactly on purpose. All four scenarios moved DOWN: P-02 7942->7912 (-30), P-03 14002->13939 (-63), P-04 7335->7307 (-28), P-05 2408->2396 (-12). Measured against a CONTROL: develop's tip (80890ea2), the branch's base, reproduced the outgoing baseline exactly on the CI runner (7942/14002/7335/2408), and the local capture of this change reproduced the CI capture of it exactly, so the deltas are this change's own. One cause: HeroPlanner used to subscribe to the store's toast and render it, so every autosave flash during a scenario re-rendered the planner composer and its children; the shell now subscribes instead, and the toast's two state changes per flash reach only the shell. Captured on the host with PERF_FORCE=1 after perf:build:profile, deterministic across 7 repetitions.
